The '''Dalonia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was the origin point of the [[Dalonian crystal]]s.<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Dalonian crystal]]|system=Dalonia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dalonia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
